headline: Time Securities Services Private Limited files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for Time Technoplast Limited
sum: Time Securities Services Private Limited has filed a Regulation 10(5) disclosure under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, signalling a material stake acquisition or open offer trigger event in Time Technoplast Limited.
detail: Time Securities Services Private Limited, an affiliate or entity within the Time corporate group, has disclosed its substantial acquisition of shares in Time Technoplast Limited to NSE under Regulation 10(5) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations. The disclosure is a mandatory pre-offer or accompaniment to an open offer, and is filed on or around 15 Jun 2026. The exact acquisition quantum, timing, and consideration are not disclosed in the headline filing; full details would be in the substantive disclosure form filed with the exchange and made public.
